current_activity: Petersen's IV Luftwaffe Field Corps extends its front to over twenty-five miles, from Saulcy to Le Thillot
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 19 p. 338: "Both Petersen's IV Luftwaffe Field Corps and Kniess' LXXXV Corps also had to extend their boundaries northward, leaving the IV Luftwaffe Field Corps with a front of over twenty-five miles from Saulcy south to Route N-66 at Le Thillot". Event definition: the change took effect between 30 October and 1 November (p. 339); 31 October is the middle of the window and an approximate date. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Gérardmer, about the middle of the Saulcy-Le Thillot front, with a precision of 25 km. Location approximate: a sector point; the corps headquarters is not placed. Location support: CMH names the two ends of the front. Commander: General Petersen.

location_qualifier: boundary point with the LXIV Corps; the corps headquarters is not named
current_activity: IV Luftwaffe Field Corps (Petersen) holds the Vosges sector south of Saulcy with the 198th and 269th Divisions
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 22 p. 389: "VI Corps with the LXIV Corps as well as part of the IV Luftwaffe Field Corps"; p. 391: "Saulcy lay on the boundary between the LXIV Corps and IV Luftwaffe Field Corps". Event definition: the situation of 10 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Saulcy-sur-Meurthe with a precision of 25 km, the northern boundary point of the corps sector. Location approximate: the boundary town for the corps sector. Location support: CMH names Saulcy as the boundary with the LXIV Corps. Commander: Petersen. Opponents: US VI Corps (36th Infantry Division) and French II Corps.
